subject.title: fix(agents): load bootstrap files from agentDir alongside workspace

question: Should an explicitly configured `agentDir` become a second bootstrap-instruction root that overrides the agent workspace, or should OpenClaw preserve workspace-only authority and warn about misplaced files?
rationale: Both outcomes are technically possible, but they define different product, compatibility, session-context, and security boundaries; current documentation and setup flows support workspace-only authority.

options.title: Keep Workspace Authoritative
options.body: Remove the `agentDir` merge and provide an actionable warning or Doctor recovery path directing users to `agents.list[].workspace`.

options.title: Approve Two Bootstrap Roots
options.body: Keep the merge only after documenting precedence, adding fresh-install and upgrade coverage, and proving that existing state directories cannot unexpectedly supersede workspace policy.

options.title: Pause for Canonical Fix
options.body: Pause or close this implementation and choose one of the linked warning-oriented or merge-oriented PRs after comparing their proof and compatibility behavior.

recommendation.title: Keep Workspace Authoritative
recommendation.body: Remove the `agentDir` merge and provide an actionable warning or Doctor recovery path directing users to `agents.list[].workspace`.

likelyOwner.reason: The related workspace-bootstrap report was resolved under this reviewer's workspace-authority interpretation, so they are the strongest available owner for confirming or changing that product contract.
